- Type: Time (Minutes)

- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- Description: QR label batch remediation for Kirsten's two cacao batches (8oz Organic Nibs Ilheus Brazil 2024, 187 codes; Ceremonial 200g Paulo 2024 AGL8, 209 codes). Delivered REV7: rebuilt qr_highres/ (previously bare QR, no branding) using the canonical lineage-assets/scripts/qr_generator/batch_compiler.py -- generate_qr_image(logo_ratio=0.25) -> compile_image() -- now carrying tree logo inside the QR, harvest year, farm+state+country, 'Your tree is getting planted', and vertical serial, at 1350x1050 (3x density, 900 dpi effective at canonical 1.50x1.17 in). Verified 396/396 decode (pyzbar native) + 396/396 branding colour-count PASS + integrity OK; both zips under the upload cap. Diagnosis work: audited the channel's six same-named zips and flagged the four superseded builds in place; disproved the --box-size approach with a 5-point sweep (label pinned at 450x350 with 5px modules for box 10-20, because compile_image fits the QR into a fixed QR_BASE_SIZE=320 on a fixed canvas -- CANVAS_SCALE is the real resolution knob); traced 7 apparent decode failures to opencv-on-large-image artifacts plus LANCZOS blur from non-integer module sizing, fixed by deriving a per-id integer box_size so the internal resize is an identity; root-caused the Discord upload rejection to parallel sends rather than the 25 MB cap; reproduced the canonical 1x label and diffed it (33,926 -> 10,566 px) before scaling, including finding a 2px QR vertical offset (FIXED_QR_Y=-30 not -32) and installing Arial-metric fonts. Filed OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md PR #1670 (manifest scan_target != QR payload; attachment misroute). Time basis (estimate, adjustable): ~5 full 396-file render cycles ~20 min, 6 full 396-file verification passes ~30 min, caption-defect audit decoding 396 embedded QR payloads, ~20 heavy diagnostic rounds (sweeps, offset hunts, dual-decoder cross-checks), channel audit and in-place flagging. PRs: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1670
